extension.description: Professional language support for KUKA Robot Language (KRL) in VS Code
command.aiCheckSafety: Run AI Safety & Velocity Diagnostic Check
command.compareKrcBackup: Compare File & Point Deltas with KRC Backup Archive (.zip)
command.sendLogsToDeveloper: Send Extension Diagnostic Logs to Developer
command.viewFileHistory: View KRL File History & Compare Revisions
command.viewGitGraph: Open KRL Revision Graph & Point Timeline
command.showLineBlameDetails: Show KRL Line Git Blame Details
command.convertToIiqkaFold: Convert Selection to iiQKA Motion Fold
command.convertLegacyToSpline: Convert Legacy Motions to Modern Splines (KSS 8.6+ / 8.7)
command.errorLens.toggleInlineMessage: Error Lens: Toggle Inline Message Text
command.errorLens.searchForProblem: Error Lens: Search Problem on Web
command.errorLens.disableLine: Error Lens: Suppress Diagnostic on Current Line
command.diffWithPrevious: Compare Line with Previous Commit Revision (Diff)
config.title: KUKA KRL Extension
config.autoFold.description: Automatically fold all regions when opening a KRL file
config.indentWidth.description: Number of spaces for indentation (3 = KUKA Teach Pendant standard)
config.separateBeforeBlocks.description: Add empty line before control blocks (FOR, IF, WHILE, LOOP, etc.)
config.separateAfterBlocks.description: Add empty line after control blocks (ENDFOR, ENDIF, ENDWHILE, etc.)
config.validateNonAscii.description: Highlight non-ASCII characters (Cyrillic, special symbols) that may cause errors in KUKA controller
config.errorLens.enabled: Show diagnostic messages inline at the end of lines
config.errorLens.inlineMessageEnabled: Show inline diagnostic text at line ends (toggle with command)
config.errorLens.followCursor: Controls whether to show diagnostics on all lines, only the active cursor line, or the closest problem
config.errorLens.messageBackgroundMode: Highlight line background (line), only message background (message), or text only (none)
config.errorLens.gutterIconsEnabled: Show diagnostic severity icons in the editor gutter margin
config.errorLens.delay: Delay in milliseconds before rendering diagnostic decorations while editing
config.errorLens.onSave: Only refresh diagnostic decorations when saving the document
config.errorLens.alignMessage: Align inline error messages to a fixed column (e.g. 80). Set to 0 to disable
config.errorLens.maxCharsPerLine: Maximum character length for inline diagnostic messages before truncating
config.errorLens.statusBarEnabled: Show active file diagnostics and cursor line problem in the status bar
config.errorLens.fontStyleItalic: Render inline diagnostic message in italic font style
config.alignAssignments: Align assignment operators (=) in consecutive lines
view.krlIO.welcome:
No I/O signals found in the current workspace. Use $IN[n], $OUT[n], etc. in your KRL code to see them here.
[Refresh](command:krl.refreshIOView)
config.inlayHints.enabled: Show descriptive names for I/O signals and system data as inline hints.
config.codeLens.enabled: Show CodeLens hints for references and documentation.
config.callHierarchy.enabled: Enable Call Hierarchy support for functions.
config.documentHighlights.enabled: Highlight occurrences of the same variable/function in the document.
config.supportGatewayUrl: Liskin Labs Support Desk Gateway URL (Direct Engineering Support Relay).
config.telemetry.enabled: Enable heartbeat and status pings to Liskin Labs Support Gateway (disable for air-gapped industrial cells).
config.gitLens.currentLine.enabled: Show Git Blame annotations inline at the end of the current line.
